reviews.title: Fantastic sound, but be sure to set it up right.
reviews.comment: As with most hardware with accompanying software, the software truly isn't great. So, for a good setup, use the included DAC, install G Hub, disable side tone if you want, I did because hearing myself is disorienting, adjust any EQ levels you want, I gave it a bass boost, and then save those setting to the DAC. Then, uninstall G Hub. G Hub has issues, like when I'd try to max out the mic, since I can adjust that later through Voicemeeter, it refused to let me. It kept turning itself back down with no option I saw to disable automatic gain control, so you're better off saving specific things to the DAC, then uninstalling it, it's not friendly with other software. After that, you'll have a good headset which won't make adjustments on it's own magically lol Mic: The SE variant does have a different mic than the classic, at least different from the classic I bought over a year ago, and it does make me sound better, so that's a nice upgrade. My voice sounds clean, and though it does pick up background noise, very sensitive, that's easy to handle with Nvidia Broadcast, or Krisp, or any number of other noise cancellation softwares. I tried the Blue Voice thing, it was horrible, so, again, software bad. Sound: Compared to other headsets I tried before buying this as a replacement for my old Pro X that broke, most miss out on the bass and other low spots, but this covers it fairly nicely. You can adjust it later too using something like Equalizer APO. I tried a Cloud III from HyperX before buying this, wanted to see what others offered, and that thing sounded so flat, even with every equalizer I could find maxed out on the bass layered on top of each other, I'm assuming they lack the hardware, but this headset certainly delivers. Build: Most of the weak points of a headset are made of metal on here with one exception, the two clips that compress the size adjustment point, they're plastic, and held together by two screws each. This is what broke my classic variant, and I am somewhat sad to see they're still made of plastic on the SE's. I plan to have my local machine shop make me some metal replacements, since Logitech doesn't even sell plastic replacements, much less metal ones. They lasted almost a year before breaking, but they're the exact same as on the SE's, so I can take the ones from the broken headset for them to use in the process of making me metal ones which I will promptly swap. Overall: I give it a 4.5, mostly because my last ones broke in the way that they did, and a whole year later, that specific part is still made of plastic. I'll make it right myself, but I really shouldn't have to, it's a weak point, and should be made of metal. Aside from that, solid product, best sounding gaming headset I've ever used.
reviews.author: Derrik Slade

reviews.title: Best Headphones EVER
reviews.comment: My babies. The noise cancellation is a must and these do it right. The cord length is great not too long not too short. They’re just beautiful and soooo comfy too, I wear them for hours no problem. If you’re into competitive gaming these are an amazing budget option, I play escape from tarkov which has crazy audio and these headphones made it a whole new game for me in a good way. Highly recommend the app as well, you can change the audio as well as your mic settings.
reviews.author: Ash H

reviews.title: great for gaming, skip for streaming
reviews.comment: Good for gaming, garbage for streaming. If youre going directly into your controller or possibly making business calls, its a great headset. Very comfortable for long term use, build quality is solid. The logi drivers may crash your computer so you will need to tune for that if you want to use the extended EQ settings. If you want to use this for streaming? Skip it. Going into OBS, the blue voice mic tries to pick up literally everything in the room like a weird crappy condenser mic. Every click of my keyboard, hvac hum, everything. It made it painful for my viewers to tune in. I ended up selling it because of this and bought a razr which is outstanding. But as long as youre not streaming or at least in a quiet apartment with no hvac noise, its a perfect device for the price. Audio quality is very high, logitech does well in bass ranges. Highs are crisp, everything is as it should be.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: The most well-built, high-end feeling headphones made by Logitech. Too bad the sound is terrible.
reviews.comment: First off, I cannot tell you how impressed I was unboxing these cans. Not that the packaging was anything special, but was taking them out of the box. They have this immediate feeling of craftsmanship and high-end components. The milled steel plates on the side of the cups, the tight hinges with quite a bit of aluminum parts gets rid of the rattling noises, the sliding and clicking of adjusting the size, all the way to the inner foam and the way they disappear on your head. Whoever designed and built these headphones deserves an applause as everything physical about them is perfect IMO. the clamping pressure is tight, but not too tight it starts to hurt over time. The Cups and padding lay flat all around your ears with perfect with distribution in pressure and they do not squish the ear flat inside the cups at all. The padding wrapped in faux leather has this stiff feeling quality to them, which adds to the nice and tight, firm-feel of these headphones yet it does not detract from its comfort in any way. While I usually prefer squishy fabric covered memory foam, these are quite nice! However, the audio is absolutely stinking hot garbage. I bought these headphones due to a few gaming media sites adding these to their review in the best headphones category. At the very least they were given honorable mention or runner up and these are from 2019 so the reviews are old, but I am wondering if mine are defective, because there is no way anyone would recommend these over some of the other higher priced gaming headsets. I reinstalled drivers, made sure everything was plugged in properly, used a different cord, different outlets usb/3.5mm, and nothing. Now these are the G Pro X headphones, but they are the 'SE' kind which assumingly stands for special edition because it has pre-loaded EQ presets for various Esports personalities. This headset is nothing but Bass and low mid tones. When I switched headphones over I realized that in Destiny 2, when you scroll through your inventory it makes this small 'tick' sound when the mouse lands on a piece of armor or weapon/inventory item. that tick is no longer audible as are the sounds like engrams or chests make in-game. Even harvesting materials, swinging a sword or shooting weapons. The headphones just do not play certain tones! I dont know how wide the outgoing frequency is for the drivers included, but these are going to be returned asap. I just need to make up my mind as to what to try next. IF Logitech could have put the same drivers as the G635/G900 headphones and put them into these high-quality shells, it would be game over. Such a shame that physically these headphones have an almost high-end Sony studio quality feel to them, but yet sound like the 19.99 Baijyonkai ultra gamer extreme Amazon special.
reviews.author: Sly Nation

reviews.title: Hasn’t failed me
reviews.comment: The color is slick and has a nice weight that keeps your headset snug on your head. I am able to hear just fine in competitive games and oh boy you cannot hear almost anything when you wear these on. Gives you an awesome immersive experience when you use the app in PC able to adjust the bass and so many more things. I use it between my Xbox and PC and hasn’t gave me an issue. I do admit the quality is so much better when you adjust it on PC but is also great for console players. Mic is bendable and has good quality never giving me an issue talking to friends. Works as it should and will last you a very nice long time. Price makes it even better and worth it and better than most other brands that are probably more expensive.
